capabilities: Apply reusable inline formatting roles to selections
Format selected text from a context menu and popover
Override line text direction (RTL/LTR) with list-marker isolation
Configure global typography, headings, lists, and quick colors
Define custom CSS snippets for inline roles
disambiguation: Not a Markdown style tidy-up tool; it adds visual formatting markup and roles rather than reformatting note layout.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; vault-wide strip, footnote, and profile commands are explicitly deferred in this pre-release.
problem: Obsidian's native Markdown only covers simple bold/italic, so reusable inline styles, custom typography, and reliable text-direction control require manual CSS or markup.
summary: Typography and user-defined inline formatting roles applied live in the editor, with quick colors, direction overrides, and Arabic/RTL support.
